description:
Green Academia , also known by various other names, [ Note 1 ] is a splinter Academia aesthetic specializing in biology and earth sciences, especially botany, ecology, geobiology, mycology, and zoology. Green Academia is similar to Goblincore in its appreciation of nature , collecting of trinkets, and, in some respects, fashion, however Green Academia has more of a focus on knowledge and science, mainly environmental science.

Although social sciences are emphasized less in Green Academia than in other academic aesthetics, philosophy, natural history, and environmental sociology are featured in various forms throughout green academia media. Arts including poetry, sculpture, and drawing are popular in green academia text posts and images.
